title: Edit imported {noun}
desc: <mono>{label}</mono> comes from vanilla or a loaded mod — what happens if you edit it?
keepImportedDesc: Discard this change. Export keeps the vanilla or mod original.
overrideDesc: After you save, this becomes your own edit and export overwrites the vanilla or mod original. The id stays the same.
createCopyDesc: After you save, the imported original stays and you get a standalone {entityType}. Both exist in the build.
